name: lflsf LF5: the same label-free pipeline with the margin at the 8x perturbation scale (neg_log_sens_8) instead of 4x
registered: 2026-10-25 18:07 EDT, before any x8 margin net or value existed and before any LF3 lfa / lfr result beyond lfa-15
motivation: LF3's first switch arm (lfa-15, rate-matched eps) cut dev topples 27 -> 14 but logged successes 40 -> 13 (lifts 50 -> 16): the switch blocks the grasp. Exploratory check on the TRAINING runs only (paired_record_m3 untouched; scratchpad an/margins.py, labels for grading): with the bottom tenth of visited states as the failure set, the 4x margin flags 18% of safe gripper-closed states vs 45% of states 1 chunk before a topple; the 8x margin flags 9% vs 33% (spread30) / 8% vs 37% (spread10), i.e. the grasp is no longer marked fragile while pre-topple states still are. Toppled scenes are calm under every scale (flagged 0-9%), so no hold-plan spread marks the failed state itself; the HJ min-over-time backup carries the danger of passing through fragile states.
stage_LF5a_margin: eval/lflsf.py margin with LF_SCALE=8: identical to LF1 except m = -log(spread30 at 8x / 16) (q10, s from its own training distribution). -> margin_lf8.pt, results/jenga/lflsf_LF1_x8.json. Gate = LF1's (held-out Spearman >= 0.6, AUC >= target's - 0.05).
stage_LF5b_value: eval/lsf.py sac exactly as LF2 with LSF_CLF=margin_lf8.pt -> value_lf8_alea.pt. Gate = LF2's (eval/lsf_audit.py + lsf_diag.py; lflsf.py gate2 reading the x8 files).
stage_LF5c_dev: the LF3 dev protocol (episodes 15000-15099, paired with paired_record_lflsfdev, local). eps by the LABEL-FREE matched-rate rule of amendment 2: eps_r = the quantile of the x8 value V(z, g) over all held-out m3 decision states at the rates the labelled stage 2 value flags at eps 0.10 / 0.30 (5.4% / 6.9%). Arms: absolute switch at both eps (lfa8 modes) and the latent-CBF edit (lfc, gamma 0.5) at the 6.9% eps. Selection over ALL lflsf arms (LF3, LF4, LF5): the LSF dev rule (fewest replay-audited topples among arms with v4 >= policy - 5 pp), ties -> fewer overrides; v4 and v4b reported.
after: the overall selected arm -> a separately pre-registered fresh-episode head-to-head vs LSF stage 2 (labelled lsfa030) and psel.
scope: label-free, task-agnostic, off-the-shelf DINOv2 latent model_OIL; topple labels for grading only.
